description: A full-bleed photo or video that slowly drifts closer, with a title and a caption over a soft shade. For the picture that says it best.

image.description: A file in assets/ (png, jpg, svg, or an mp4/webm video); it fills the whole slide

alt.description: What the image shows, for people who can't see it

credit.description: Who took the photo; shown small in the corner

side.description: Which side the words are on
